note: Domain 2 Economics configuration (demo defaults, editable at later stages — Yasser GO 2026-10-11). Values are configuration data, NOT industrial calibration claims; every entry keeps sme_pending=true until SME calibration. Rule logic lives in mirror/economics_domain2_mirror.py; this file carries only tunable parameters. Grade price bands live in content/prices/price_ladder_draft.json (single source of truth — economics does NOT re-define them). Canonical units per docs/foundations_definitions.md.

sales_index.note: Yasser-approved 2026-10-10: band 0.85-1.05, walk step 0.02 per day, mean-reverting toward 1.0. Seeded RNG walk only — economics consumes no other RNG draws (RNG contract belongs to Domain 3).

demand_gate.note: Below this index customers do not take delivery; tonnes stay as finished_yard inventory (material stored, not lost — balance-safe). Demo value, editable later.

order_book.unit: percent of order signed value per day late, capped at cap_pct
order_book.note: Recommended demo value 1.5%/day capped at 10% (flagged sme_pending). Penalty accrues on the FULL signed order value (tonnage x price_mid at signing), not on remaining tonnage at fulfillment. Late-delivery risk is the forward-contract trade-off (playability).

qc_tiers.unit: percent haircut applied to grade price_mid
qc_tiers.note: QC tier = how many price bands the chemistry fell below the assigned grade (0=prime, 1=secondary, 2+=prompt). Downgrade trigger: chemistry fail on Cu/Sn gate -> next passing band. Grade assignment rule is NOT re-implemented here — it is grade_pricing_mirror.assign_grade (highest price-band midpoint the chemistry passes, inclusive at-limit). Haircuts are recommended demo values, flagged sme_pending.

utilities.unit: USD per tonne processed per day (per asset, per utility)
utilities.note: Per-asset daily utility cost breakdown. Config-driven only — engine logic contains no hard-coded commercial assumptions. Demo values, editable later.

specific_energy.unit: kWh per tonne processed and Nm3 NG per tonne processed (per asset)
specific_energy.note: Specific energy consumption KPI per asset. Zero-production days report KPI as None/NA — never 0, never a division by zero. Demo values, editable later.
